verdict.rationale: Lambda serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec for the Lambda Cloud API at cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json. A runtime probe confirmed it downloads without an API key and covers the full API, including rate limits. The 404s on docs.lambda.ai candidate paths only show the spec is not mirrored there; they do not contradict its availability. Missing for 10: documented discoverability of the spec from the main docs site (docs-domain paths and llms.txt return 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: https://cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json serves the full Lambda Cloud API OpenAPI 3.1 spec (title 'Lambda Cloud API', documented rate limits: 1 req/s general, launch limited per 12s) keylessly
The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
